A '''fire-starting kit''' was a mass-produced product created and sold by the [[Gazar|Gazarans]]. They sold the items to tourists, alongside primitive [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrods]], climbing gear, and short-range [[Distress beacon/Legends|distress beacons]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
